location.en: Kai's studio, on the phone with Mr. Lin
location.zh: 凱的套房，打電話給林先生

goal.en: Report the broken heater and arrange a repair.
goal.zh: 向房東報修壞掉的暖氣，約好維修時間。

background: small studio apartment on a cold winter night, frosty window, old white radiator heater under the window, bed with a thick wool blanket, mug on a wooden desk, dim cool blue light

intro.en: Two weeks after moving in, the first cold night arrives. The heater makes a loud clunk, then goes silent.
intro.zh: 搬進來兩週後，第一個寒夜來了。暖氣「喀」的一聲，然後就沒聲音了。

intro.en: Wrapped in a blanket, you call Mr. Lin.
intro.zh: 你裹著毯子，打電話給林先生。

lines.en: Hello, Lin speaking. Kai? Is everything okay?
lines.zh: 喂，我是林先生。凱嗎？一切都還好嗎？

choices.en: Hi, Mr. Lin. Sorry to call so late. The heater isn't working.
choices.zh: 林先生您好，抱歉這麼晚打來。暖氣壞了。
choices.tip: The heater isn't working. 是描述東西故障最自然的說法，先為打擾道歉再說問題更有禮貌。

choices.en: Hi, Mr. Lin. The heater is bad. It doesn't come out hot air.
choices.zh: 林先生您好，暖氣壞了，沒有出熱風。

lines.en: The heater is bad? Does it smell bad? Try opening a window.
lines.zh: 暖氣不好？是有怪味嗎？開個窗戶試試。

story.en: Mr. Lin thinks the heater just smells funny. On the coldest night of the year, you sit next to an open window.
story.zh: 林先生以為暖氣只是有怪味。在今年最冷的一晚，你坐在打開的窗戶旁邊發抖。

fail.why: 「壞掉」不能直譯成 bad，bad 容易被理解成「味道不好、品質差」。東西故障要說 isn't working 或 is broken：The heater isn't working.

choices.en: Your heater is broken. I'm freezing here. Come and fix it right now.
choices.zh: 你的暖氣壞了，我快冷死了。現在馬上來修。

lines.en: Right now? It's ten o'clock at night, Kai.
lines.zh: 現在？現在是晚上十點耶，凱。

story.en: Mr. Lin says he'll send someone "when he has time." Apparently, that means next Thursday.
story.zh: 林先生說「有空的時候」會找人過去。看來那是指下週四。

fail.why: 用命令句 Come and fix it right now. 對房東太衝，對方只會不想幫你。先道歉再說明：Sorry to call so late. The heater isn't working.

lines.en: Oh no, on a night like this! When did it stop working?
lines.zh: 糟糕，偏偏在這種晚上！什麼時候壞的？

choices.en: It's been broken since about eight o'clock this evening.
choices.zh: 從今晚八點左右就壞了。
choices.tip: It's been broken since + 時間點，用現在完成式說明「從那時到現在一直壞著」。

choices.en: It is broken since eight o'clock. Now it still broken.
choices.zh: 從八點就壞了，現在還是壞的。

lines.en: Sorry, so is it working now or not? I'm a little confused.
lines.zh: 抱歉，所以現在到底能不能用？我有點搞混了。

story.en: Mr. Lin thinks the heater fixed itself and goes back to his TV show. You sleep in two pairs of socks.
story.zh: 林先生以為暖氣自己好了，回去繼續看電視。你穿了兩雙襪子睡覺。

fail.why: 從過去持續到現在的狀態要用現在完成式：It's been broken since eight o'clock.，不能說 It is broken since...。

choices.en: It stopped because it's so cold tonight, minus two degrees!
choices.zh: 因為今晚太冷了才壞的，零下兩度！

lines.en: Yes, I know it's cold. But when did it stop?
lines.zh: 對，我知道很冷。但它是什麼時候壞的？

story.en: You and Mr. Lin talk about the weather for ten minutes. The heater remains a mystery.
story.zh: 你和林先生聊了十分鐘天氣。暖氣的問題依然成謎。

fail.why: When 問的是時間，不是原因或天氣。直接回答時間點：It's been broken since about eight.

lines.en: Hmm. There's a small switch on the side. Have you tried turning it off and on?
lines.zh: 嗯，旁邊有個小開關。你試過關掉再打開嗎？

choices.en: Yes, I've already tried that twice, but nothing happened.
choices.zh: 有，我已經試過兩次了，但沒有反應。
choices.tip: I've already tried that. 用現在完成式表示「已經做過了」，讓對方知道基本檢查都做完了。

choices.en: Yes, I opened it and closed it, but it's still no reaction.
choices.zh: 有，我打開又關掉了，但還是沒反應。

lines.en: You opened the heater? Please don't take it apart!
lines.zh: 你把暖氣拆開了？拜託別拆它！

story.en: Mr. Lin spends the rest of the call warning you not to touch anything with a screwdriver. Nobody mentions the switch again.
story.zh: 林先生接下來整通電話都在叮嚀你千萬別拿螺絲起子亂動。再也沒人提到開關的事。

fail.why: 中文說「打開、關掉」電器，英文要用 turn on / turn off，不是 open / close。可以說 I've already turned it off and on again.

choices.en: Of course I tried that already. I'm not a little kid, you know.
choices.zh: 我當然試過了。我又不是小孩子。

lines.en: All right, all right. I was only trying to help.
lines.zh: 好啦好啦，我只是想幫忙。

story.en: Mr. Lin's voice goes cold, just like your studio. He says he'll call a repair company "sometime this week."
story.zh: 林先生的語氣跟你的套房一樣冷了下來。他說「這週找時間」再叫維修公司。

fail.why: 語氣太衝會讓好意幫忙的房東覺得不被尊重。平和地說 Yes, I've already tried that, but nothing happened. 就好。

lines.en: Then it needs a repair. I'll call the repair company first thing tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 那就需要維修了。我明天一早就打給維修公司。

choices.en: Thank you. When could someone come? I'll be home after three.
choices.zh: 謝謝。大概什麼時候會有人來？我三點以後在家。
choices.tip: When could someone come? 用 could 讓詢問更委婉，再補上自己方便的時間，對方好安排。

choices.en: Thanks. When someone can come? I'm at home after three o'clock.
choices.zh: 謝謝。什麼時候有人可以來？我三點以後在家。

lines.en: When someone can come... Are you asking me, or telling me?
lines.zh: 有人可以來的時候……你是在問我，還是在告訴我？

story.en: Mr. Lin thinks you said anyone can come anytime. The technician knocks at nine in the morning while you're in class.
story.zh: 林先生以為你說隨時都可以來。結果維修人員早上九點來敲門時，你正在上課。

fail.why: 疑問句要把助動詞放在主詞前面：When could someone come?，不能說 When someone can come?

choices.en: Oh, no hurry at all. I can wait until spring, don't worry.
choices.zh: 喔，完全不急。我可以等到春天，別擔心。

lines.en: Until spring? Well... if you're sure. I'll put it on my list.
lines.zh: 等到春天？嗯……既然你這麼說，我就先記下來。

story.en: Mr. Lin takes you at your word. The repair person arrives in March, and you spend the whole winter in a wool hat.
story.zh: 林先生把你的話當真了。維修人員三月才來，你戴著毛帽度過了整個冬天。

fail.why: 台灣人常客氣地說「不急、沒關係」，但在楓灣大家會照字面理解。需要修就清楚說：When could someone come? I'll be home after three.

lines.en: I'll send someone at three thirty. And Kai, there's an extra blanket in the closet.
lines.zh: 我三點半找人過去。還有，凱，衣櫃裡有一條備用毯子。

lines.en: The next afternoon, the heater hums back to life.
lines.zh: 隔天下午，暖氣又嗡嗡地運轉起來了。

story.en: The repair person replaces a small part in ten minutes. Your studio is warm again, and Mr. Lin even calls to check on you.
story.zh: 維修人員十分鐘就換好一個小零件。套房又暖了，林先生還特地打電話來關心。

notes.explain: 東西故障最常用 isn't working，也可以說 is broken。別說 is bad，聽起來像品質差或有怪味。

example.en: The shower isn't working. There's no hot water.

notes.explain: 現在完成式 has / have been + 狀態 + since + 時間點，表示從過去持續到現在。

example.en: The light has been flickering since Monday.
example.zh: 燈從星期一就一直在閃。

notes.zh: 大概什麼時候能有人來？
notes.explain: could 比 can 委婉。用 someone 是因為你不知道會派誰來。問完記得補上自己方便的時間。

example.en: When could someone come to take a look? I'm free after three.
example.zh: 大概什麼時候能有人來看看？我三點以後有空。

notes.explain: 電器的開關用 turn on / turn off，不是 open / close。open 是打開門、窗、蓋子這類東西。

example.en: I turned the heater off and on again.

notes.explain: 楓灣人通常照字面理解。客套地說 No hurry.，對方真的會慢慢來。需要盡快處理，就禮貌但清楚地說出時間。

example.en: It's quite cold, so I'd appreciate it if someone could come tomorrow.
example.zh: 這裡滿冷的，如果明天能有人來，我會很感謝。
